subject: MAP: Vendor onboarding / procurement steps (Acme) - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Porter <jane.porter@acme.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-10T15:32:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: Vendor onboarding / procurement steps (Acme) - post-call recap

Hi Jane / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for taking time today — great conversation. As promised, attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) capturing the procurement/vendor onboarding milestones we discussed so we can align on owners and target dates. Quick recap of the important vendor onboarding items we flagged: 

- Vendor registration in Ariba/Coupa (Acme supplier onboarding)
- Completion of vendor forms (Redwood vendor packet / Acme vendor requirements)
- W-9 (you mentioned you’d send)
- Banking details for ACH/PO remittance
- PO issuance and target go-live

Attached: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (draft MAP + checklist). Please confirm the preferred supplier system (Ariba vs Coupa) and the supplier admin contact so we can add Redwood into your system.

Proposed high-level timeline (open to adjustments):
- Vendor packet returned: target 2026-07-16 (owner: Acme procurement)
- Vendor registration in Coupa/Ariba: target 2026-07-20 (owner: Acme procurement)
- Banking details verified: target 2026-07-22 (owner: Acme finance)
- PO issued: target 2026-08-12 (owner: Acme procurement)
- Go-live / first calls: target 2026-08-20 (owner: Redwood + Acme)

Next steps: can you confirm who will own each of those milestones on your side and whether you can share the W-9 and banking details? I’ll loop in our finance contact Rachel to help with billing and bank setup, and Dev to handle any technical onboarding questions.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a DocuSign link for the vendor packet if that’s easiest for the team.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
[Attachment: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx]

From: Jane Porter <jane.porter@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2026-07-11T09:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Vendor onboarding / procurement steps (Acme) - post-call recap

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the recap and the MAP. Per our call: we use Coupa for supplier onboarding (we do still accept Ariba in some BU pockets, but this engagement will be processed through Coupa). I’m copying the procurement mailbox for visibility.

I’ve attached our W-9 and a current banking remittance note. We’ll need Redwood’s vendor packet (we prefer a DocuSign flow) and Redwood’s remit/bank details and Tax ID to complete the Coupa profile.

Attaching: Acme_W9.pdf, banking_details.txt (internal reference).

Target I can commit to from procurement: complete supplier registration and approvals by 2026-08-12 (this aligns with your PO issuance target). I’ll try to get the vendor packet completed earlier — the team aims for 2026-07-16 for returning forms.

Questions:
- Do you have a Redwood vendor form or is DocuSign preferred?
- Who should I add as the supplier contact (name/email) in Coupa while the packet is processed?

Thanks,
Jane Porter
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Corp
jane.porter@acme.com
[Attachments: Acme_W9.pdf, banking_details.txt]

- We can support Coupa supplier onboarding; we have a standard vendor packet and a short DocuSign form for vendor details. I’m attaching the Redwood_Vendor_Packet.pdf for reference.
